video.title: Example breakdown (illustrative): a melodic Chicago drill type beat

result.vibe: Cold, cinematic and bittersweet: glassy bells and wide pads over sliding 808s and choppy drill drums.

drums.kick: Sparse kick that lands with the 808, mostly on the downbeat and a couple of syncopated off-beat spots.
drums.snare_clap: Clap on beat 3 of each bar plus drill's off-beat snare hits just before or after it.
drums.hi_hats: Triplet-feel hats with stops and short rolls rather than a constant 16th stream.
drums.percussion: An open hat or crash to mark each 8-bar phrase; occasional rim or perc hit.
drums.groove: Choppy, stop-start drill bounce; space between hits matters as much as the hits.

result.bass_808: Long, distorted 808 that glides between notes (octave and fifth slides) and follows the chord roots.

melody.lead_sound: Glassy bell/pluck synth over wide, lush string-like pads.
melody.approach: A simple, catchy, repeating motif over an 8-bar loop that keeps the midrange open.
melody.harmony: An emotional minor progression with a dark-but-uplifting feel (think i - VI - VII).
melody.layers: Atmospheric pad bed, bright bell motif, and a higher shimmering layer that enters later for lift.

arrangement.what_happens: Pads and bell melody set the mood; a subtle riser leads into the first drop.
Full drums, 808 and melody slam in together with an open-hat/crash impact.
Drums and 808 keep rolling while a subtle high synth adds movement without crowding vocals.
808 and main drums drop out, leaving chords and bells to rebuild tension.
Full beat returns for a strong final hook and rides out.

mix_notes: Cut lows below about 120-150 Hz on pads and bells so they never clash with the 808.
Keep kick, clap and 808 centered; spread the pads wide.
Distort the 808 a little so it cuts through on phone speakers.
A soft clipper on the master lets the kick and 808 hit hard without clipping.

fl_studio_sounds.suggestion: FLEX bell or music-box preset, with Fruity Reeverb 2
FLEX or Sytrus dark string/pad preset, low-cut under 150 Hz
A stock 808 from Packs (or FLEX 808 preset) with glide on
Stock Packs kick, clap, snare, closed hat, open hat

boothmate_prompts: Set the tempo to 133 BPM and add markers for an 8-bar Intro at bar 1, a 16-bar Hook at bar 9, a 16-bar Verse at bar 25 and an 8-bar Breakdown at bar 41.
Program drill drums for 4 bars with a fill in the last bar on my Kick, Clap, Snare, Hat and Open Hat channels.
Write a drill 808 in D minor with the dark mood, 1 bar per chord, repeated twice, on my 808 channel.
Write dark chords in D minor on my Pad channel, 1 bar per chord, repeated twice.
Write an original, sparse bell melody in D minor on my Bell channel: high register, a few long notes per bar, landing on chord tones on beats 1 and 3, with a small answer phrase every second bar.
Clone the current pattern as 'Breakdown' so I can strip it down to just the pad and bell.

Name my mixer tracks Kick, Clap, Snare, Hat, Open Hat, 808, Pad and Bell, keep kick, clap, snare and 808 centered, pan the hats a little right and the bell a little left, and set the pad about 4 dB lower than the bell.
result.notes: This is an illustrative example showing the layout of a breakdown, written by hand, not a live analysis of the video. Earlier versions of this example said 'Melodic Trap, 180 BPM'; it now matches the reading of a live preview (Chicago drill, about 133 BPM, D minor). Results are estimates.
result.style_why: Sliding 808s and syncopated off-beat snares with triplet-feel hats are drill drums; the bells and pads make it the melodic side of drill.
result.bpm_why: The main clap lands on beat 3 of each bar with off-beat snares around it, which reads as about 133 BPM; 66 is too slow for drill and 266 is far outside the range.
result.key_why: The 808 keeps returning to D and the bell loop resolves on a D minor chord.

mixer_chains.chain: Fruity Soft Clipper -> Fruity Blood Overdrive (low mix) -> Fruity Parametric EQ 2 (low-cut under 30 Hz) -> Fruity Limiter
mixer_chains.why: Distortion makes the 808 audible on small speakers, as on drill records.

mixer_chains.chain: Fruity Parametric EQ 2 -> Fruity Limiter (gentle) -> Fruity Soft Clipper
mixer_chains.why: Glues the kit and lets the clap snap.

mixer_chains.chain: Fruity Parametric EQ 2 (low-cut ~150 Hz) -> Fruity Reeverb 2 (big room, low mix) -> Fruity Delay 3 (1/4 dotted, low mix)
mixer_chains.why: Keeps the lows for the 808 and gives the cold, wide space.

performance_tips: Set hats around 60-80% velocity with accents on a few hits so they don't sound robotic.
Give the 808 a slide time of about 1/16 so the glides are audible but not mushy.
Keep kick, clap, snare and 808 centered; pan the bell slightly and keep the pad wide.
